name: neurosys
description: Front-end sources for neurosys.gg. Compiles assets/ts/ to public/assets/js/, inlines assets/css/main.css into public/assets/css/style.css, then content-hashes both into src/NeuroSYS/AssetManifest.php. `build:prod` derives build/dist/ from that: the same tree minified, with the source maps dropped, and its own manifest.
